behaviour: A dry-cured, fermented sausage of beef, sometimes with lamb, spiced with garlic, cumin and red pepper and sold in a horseshoe or a straight length. In Turkey it is eaten cooked: sliced thin and fried, it gives up a red, spiced fat within moments and its edges curl and crisp. Fried too long or too hot it turns hard and bitter.

contains.basis: It is a sausage of beef.
Traditional sucuk holds no pork, but some bought kinds may blend it in.
A natural casing is part of the gut of an animal.
Cured sausages are often kept with preservatives.
Some sausages are made with milk protein.
Some sausages are made with a cereal filler.
